messages.subject: Spatial projections of StatePlane Data
parts:
Hello!

I have some coordinates in CA StatePlane II Northing/Easting format:

> head(xy.df)
  Trace_No         X         Y ID
2        1 670160128 197154918  A
3        2 670160179 197154906  A
4        3 670160179 197154893  A
5        4 670160179 197154880  A
6        5 670160230 197154867  A
7        6 670160230 197154854  A

(locations are on the Sacramento River near Sacramento proper)
and I want to turn them into polylines (shapefiles) but I can't seem to get the projection/coordinates to read properly.

This is the projection I'm assuming I would use: https://epsg.io/2226 

Here's the code I'm using with the part that doesn't work in red:
projection <- CRS("+init=EPSG:2226")
 
  # Convert to SpatialPointsDataFrame
  coordinates(xy.df) <- ~ X + Y
  proj4string(xy.df) <- CRS(projection)

  lines <- SpatialLines(list(Lines(list(Line(xy.df)), "id")),
                          proj4string=projection)

The error I get is:
Error in CRS(projection) :
  no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector

I'd appreciate any help!!
Thanks!
Lily
